provider: EUMETSAT / EUMETNET / NORDLIS / European Weather Cloud

request_contract.parameter_rules: Documentation only. Exact asset path; no new automated requests or bulk transfer authorized.

response_contract.format: Co-registered OPERA radar composites, SEVIRI rapid scan radiances and ground lightning in Zarr
response_contract.scientific_semantics: EWC guide https://confluence.ecmwf.int/spaces/EWCLOUDKB/pages/488063253/Using%2BEUMETSAT%2Bdata%2Bbuckets%2Blocal%2Bdata%2Bpool lists bucket opera-seviri-nordlis.composite.zarr, endpoint https://s3.r1.cloud.eumetsat.int, 2018-2023. EWC-internal credential-free access does not imply public internet access or uniform rights. OPERA data policy https://www.eumetnet.eu/data-access/data-policy/ announces CC BY 4.0 via MeteoGate for qualifying products; SEVIRI and NORDLIS terms must be checked independently. No bucket bytes tested; verify Zarr chunk layout, spatial/time alignment, coverage masks and licensing per layer. Radar composites not necessarily hail size labels. On 2026-11-25 an anonymous HTTPS GET of https://s3.r1.cloud.eumetsat.int/opera-seviri-nordlis.composite.zarr/.zmetadata from authorized macOS returned HTTP 403. This confirms public-internet access was not demonstrated; it does not refute documented EWC-internal availability. Request EWC access and exact layer terms; no Zarr bytes downloaded.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: Review provider terms and explicit request/byte budget before any future execution.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: Freeze exact asset/version, UTC retrieval, size and SHA-256; mutable metadata is not data identity.

rights_and_policy.notes: Anonymous GET 403. Request EWC access and individual OPERA, SEVIRI and NORDLIS permissions; confirm storage/compute conditions, chunk size and alignment. Do not automate public access.

notes: Open-first qualification. Anonymous GET 403. Request EWC access and individual OPERA, SEVIRI and NORDLIS permissions; confirm storage/compute conditions, chunk size and alignment. Do not automate public access. No admission or authorization to acquire data.
